prompt: I have a design doc at `.ai/spec/initial-design.md` that describes a Go adapter component for bridging OpenShift alerts into an agentic system. Break it down into implementation tasks and save them to `.ai/tasks/`.

assertions.text: Output contains numbered markdown files (NNN-name.md pattern)
Tasks are in dependency order: scaffolding before components, components before integration
Each task file has a Goal section explaining what and why
Each task file has Acceptance Criteria with verifiable outcomes
Each task file has a Test Plan section describing what to test
No tasks created for items explicitly listed under Future Work in the design doc
Tasks cover the core components: AlertManager client, Proposal builder, naming/sanitization, poll loop, health probes
Tasks are framed for an AI agent executor, not for human engineers
